about.title: Built for the Kingdom's celebrations
about.subtitle: Ratibha started with a simple idea: finding a trustworthy event planner shouldn't take weeks of messaging and guesswork. We built a marketplace where every planner is verified, every quote is transparent, and every deposit is protected until the day goes exactly as planned.

items.q: How does Ratibha match me with a planner?
items.a: Tell us your event type, city, date and budget, and we surface verified planners who fit — you compare their work and message them directly before deciding.
Yes. Your deposit is held securely and only released to your planner after the event is delivered as agreed.

items.q: Does it cost anything to use Ratibha?
items.a: Browsing planners, comparing quotes and messaging is free for customers. Planners pay a commission only on confirmed bookings.

items.q: Can I message a planner before booking?
items.a: Yes — every planner profile lets you reach out directly to ask questions or request a custom quote before you commit.

items.q: Are all planners on Ratibha verified?
items.a: Every planner passes a background, portfolio and reference check before their profile goes live.
